import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, "/app/tmp/t")
from harness import *
from run import run_raw, run_json

ok = True
MAXN = 4611686018427387903

# boundary config values
ok &= check("all limits zero", CFG(max_streams_bidi=0, max_streams_uni=0, max_stream_data=0,
                                   max_data=0, crypto_limit=0, buffer_packets=0, idle_ms=0),
    [key(0,"A","install"), dg(1,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[CRY(0,"")])])],
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1)], conn_open(1), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [],
        [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# crypto_limit 0 with 1 byte -> CRYPTO_BUFFER_EXCEEDED
ok &= check("crypto limit 0", CFG(crypto_limit=0), [dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[CRY(0,"aa")])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"error","CRYPTO_BUFFER_EXCEEDED",0,0)],
        conn_closed("CRYPTO_BUFFER_EXCEEDED",0,src(0,0,0)), KEYS(), 0, [],
        [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# max t value, max idle, max pn
ok &= check("max t and pn", CFG(idle_ms=1000000000), [
        dg(1000000000000,1200,[pkt("I",MAXN,True,[PAD()])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"accepted","OK",1000000000000)], conn_open(1000000000000), KEYS(), 0, [],
        [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# CLOSE code MAXN
ok &= check("close code max", CFG(), [dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[CLOSE(False,MAXN)])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"accepted","OK",0)],
        conn_closed("PEER_TRANSPORT_CLOSE",0,src(0,0,0),0,MAXN), KEYS(), 0, [],
        [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# 32-char id
long_id = "a"*32
req = {"version":1,"traces":[{"id":long_id,"config":CFG(),"events":[]}]}
rc,out,err = run_json(req)
got = json.loads(out)
good = rc==0 and got["results"][0]["id"] == long_id
print(("PASS " if good else "FAIL ")+"32 char id"); ok &= good
# id with all allowed chars
for tid in ["A-z_09", "____", "----", "Z"]:
    req = {"version":1,"traces":[{"id":tid,"config":CFG(),"events":[]}]}
    rc,out,err = run_json(req)
    got = json.loads(out)
    good = rc==0 and got["results"][0]["id"] == tid
    print(("PASS " if good else "FAIL ")+"id "+repr(tid)); ok &= good
# unicode escapes in JSON strings decode to valid id chars
rc,out,err = run_raw(b'{"version":1,"traces":[{"id":"\\u0041\\u0042","config":'
    + json.dumps(CFG()).encode() + b',"events":[]}]}')
got = json.loads(out)
good = rc==0 and got["results"][0]["id"] == "AB"
print(("PASS " if good else "FAIL ")+"unicode escape id"); ok &= good
# pretty-printed with tabs/newlines and key order shuffled
raw = b'{\n\t"traces" : [\n\t\t{"events" : [], "config" : ' + json.dumps(CFG()).encode() + b', "id" : "x"}\n\t],\n "version" : 1\n}'
rc,out,err = run_raw(raw)
got = json.loads(out)
good = rc==0 and got=={"version":1,"results":[{"id":"x","packets":[],
    "connection":{"state":"open","code":None,"at_ms":None,"source":None,"peer_code":None,"last_activity_ms":0},
    "keys":{"I":"live","H":"absent","Z":"absent","A":"absent"},"received_total":0,"streams":[],
    "crypto":[{"level":"I","highest":0,"contiguous_hex":""},{"level":"H","highest":0,"contiguous_hex":""},{"level":"A","highest":0,"contiguous_hex":""}]}]}
print(("PASS " if good else "FAIL ")+"shuffled key order/whitespace"); ok &= good
# 32 sent ranges at max endpoints
snt = {"I":[[2*i, 2*i] for i in range(32)],"H":[],"A":[]}
ok &= check("32 sent ranges", CFG(sent=snt), [dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[ACK(*[[2*i,2*i] for i in range(32)])])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"accepted","OK",0)], conn_open(0), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# sent range with MAXN endpoints
ok &= check("sent maxn", CFG(sent={"I":[[MAXN,MAXN]],"H":[],"A":[]}),
    [dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[ACK([MAXN,MAXN])])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"accepted","OK",0)], conn_open(0), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# 2048-byte data frame (max)
big = "ab"*2048
ok &= check("2048 byte frame", CFG(max_stream_data=65536, max_data=MAXN),
    [key(0,"A","install"), dg(1,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[STR(0,big,False)])])],
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1)], conn_open(1), KEYS(a="live"), 2048,
        [st(0,2048,None,False,False,big)], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# 16 packets, mixed levels with A last
ok &= check("16 mixed packets", CFG(early=True), [
        dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[PAD()]),pkt("H",0,True,[PAD()]),pkt("Z",0,True,[PAD()]),
                   pkt("I",1,True,[PAD()]),pkt("H",1,True,[PAD()]),pkt("Z",1,True,[PAD()]),
                   pkt("I",2,True,[PAD()]),pkt("H",2,True,[PAD()]),pkt("Z",2,True,[PAD()]),
                   pkt("I",3,True,[PAD()]),pkt("H",3,True,[PAD()]),pkt("Z",3,True,[PAD()]),
                   pkt("I",4,True,[PAD()]),pkt("H",4,True,[PAD()]),pkt("Z",4,True,[PAD()]),
                   pkt("A",0,True,[PAD()])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,i,"accepted","OK",0) for i in range(15)]+[pres(0,15,"buffered","NO_KEYS",0)],
        conn_open(0), KEYS(z="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# buffer_packets max 1024
evs = [dg(0,1200,[pkt("H",i,True,[PAD()])]) for i in range(16)]
evs = [dg(i*1,1200,[pkt("H",i,True,[PAD()])]) for i in range(16)]
ok &= check("queue 16", CFG(buffer_packets=1024), evs,
    RES("t",[pres(i,0,"buffered","NO_KEYS",i) for i in range(16)],
        conn_open(), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))

print("ALL PASS" if ok else "SOME FAILED")
PYEOF
